title: Activation surge mitigation and calibration orchestration for per-model layer scaling
creator: Rohan Patel
description: Problem: FP8/INT8 calibration runs for a subset of models (LLama, Mistral, Qwen) have revealed intermittent accuracy regressions driven by transient activation surges on a small number of heads and layers. Existing layer-wise scale fixes reduce mean error but are brittle when rare head-level spikes occur at long sequence lengths. Scope: add a model-aware, probe-driven orchestration that detects surge-prone heads/layers, applies targeted mitigation (temporary clamping, head-aware rescale), and integrates with the calibration harness to produce stable quant profiles. This ticket covers the runtime policy, calibration orchestration changes, validation suites, and rollout plan for runtime-1.21.
acceptance_criteria: Integration: calibration harness (ci/calib) runs produce reproducible quant profiles for LLama/Mistral/Qwen bundles across 10 seeded runs without >0.8% accuracy regression on eval-suite compared to FP32 baseline.

Mitigation: runtime applies per-request, per-head surge clamp when a head exceeds a configured z-score threshold; clamp reduces activation to prevent overflow in INT8/FP8 paths and is toggleable via model policy.
Performance: mitigation logic adds <0.6ms median latency per request in 32-token prefixes on p4d-like instance and <2% token throughput regression under typical batching workloads.
Observability: Console dashboard shows head-level surge metrics, calibration verdicts, and a rollout toggle per model version. Regression alerts trigger if accuracy drift >0.5% post-rollout.
Rollout: Canary rollout to 5% of traffic for dedicated clusters with auto-rollback on accuracy drift or error-rate increase above threshold.
tasks: Design: finalize surge detection heuristics (z-score, EWMA, tail-percentile) and mitigation actions (clamp, anneal, fallback model variant)
Runtime: implement head-level probe + clamp hook in serving runtime with a lightweight fast-path for non-surging flows
Calibration: extend calib harness to run targeted probes and emit per-layer/head rescale suggestions into quant profile metadata
Validation: add new eval-suite scenarios (long-context, adversarial prompts) for LLama/Mistral/Qwen and integrate into CI
Observability: add head-surge histograms, per-request annotations, and model policy UI in Console
Rollout: create canary config and automation for 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback criteria
Docs/Runbook: write operator guide + incident playbook for surge mitigation

risks: False positives in surge detection could cause unnecessary clamps and degrade quality for edge prompts
Mitigation logic may interact with existing KV-cache prefix caching and affect latency for certain request patterns
Model-specific policies increase surface area for config drift between hosted and private deployments
test_plan: Unit tests for detection and clamp math with randomized activation distributions
Integration tests: run calib harness on LLama/Mistral/Qwen nightly and compare profile stability across 10 seeds
Performance regression tests: p99 latency and throughput under batch sizes [1,4,8,16] on CI hardware emulation
Canary validation: measure accuracy deltas and error rates during 5% traffic window, with auto-rollback on delta>0.5%
implementation_notes: Use a compact per-request probe buffer limited to first N tokens (configurable, default 64) to detect surges without full-sequence overhead
Store per-model head thresholds in model metadata (model_policy.head_surge_threshold_z) so operators can tune per-model behavior
Calibration harness will emit 'head_rescale' and 'layer_clamp' fields in profile JSON with provenance and seed used
